title: DevOps
description: DevOps practices covering Linux, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, containers, Docker Compose, Nginx, deployment, monitoring, and logging.
learning_outcomes: Understand DevOps culture, practices, and benefits
Manage Linux systems and shell scripting
Implement CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions
Work with Docker containers and container orchestration
Configure Nginx as reverse proxy and load balancer
Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems
